name: Danube Delta
description: The river arrives at the Black Sea and breaks into 5,000 square kilometres of channels, reed beds and floating islands. It holds the largest reed bed on earth and around 300 species of bird. Villages here are reachable only by boat.
getting: Ferries and fast boats from Tulcea to Sulina and Sfântu Gheorghe. Book a local boatman for the small channels — the scheduled boats stay on the main arms and you'll see a fraction of it.
